summary: 0.2.6 adds CIO inverter support and improves transition reliability and targeting on Sable assemblies. API 1.0.0 and existing saves stay compatible.
changes: Power CIO's inverter through WWPG and safely disable redundant CIO grid couplers without deleting saved blocks or wires.
Keep normal initialization from becoming a false adapter error while preserving unavailable readings, stored history and genuine fault warnings.
Prevent runaway terminal-targeting scans on Sable assemblies while retaining exposed CEE pins, panel covers, reach limits and PG/Gauged wiring.
installation: Use Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge 21.1.231 or 21.1.248, Java 21, Create 6.0.10-280, CEE 1.1.3 or 1.1.4, Power Grid 0.6.2 and Architectury 13.0.8. Full acceptance uses CEE 1.1.3; focused Windows checks cover both CEE versions on NeoForge 21.1.248. Match server and client mod versions.
optional_installation: Pinout editions also require CC:Tweaked 1.120.2 and CC;CPG: Pinout 0.2.1.
